task.description: Write comprehensive test specs for Lua integration (LUA-01 through LUA-05). Specs must cover: binary dependency verification (LUA-01), state isolation (LUA-02), stdlib restrictions with positive/negative cases (LUA-03), bytecode rejection (LUA-04), and host API availability and capability checks (LUA-05).
acceptance_criteria: Positive and negative test cases for each requirement
Coverage includes edge cases (empty state, concurrent executions, missing capabilities)

result.summary: Comprehensive test specification completed for LUA-01 through LUA-05. Spec includes 50+ test cases covering binary dependency verification, state isolation, stdlib restrictions with positive/negative cases, bytecode rejection, and host API availability with capability enforcement. All requirements mapped to specific test cases.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER for test implementation and execution
